Introduction

YeonJi is a South Korean singer and dancer under MODHAUS.

YeonJi was introduced as the twelfth member of the girl group tripleS on January 18, 2023. She debuted with the sub-unit EVOLution on October 11, 2023, with the mini album "⟡". YeonJi then made her debut with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".

As a member of tripleS, YeonJi was placed in the sub-units EVOLution, Visionary Vision, and Zenith.
